charter: Find defects that make the change set compute the wrong result, drop or duplicate information, or corrupt state.

inputs.summary: Review order_service apply and paging helpers.

issues.title: apply_line_items pops the caller's items list
issues.whats_wrong: while items: item = items.pop() mutates the caller-owned cart in place.
issues.why_it_matters: The caller loses remaining lines after a debit and cannot retry or audit the cart.
how_to_fix: Iterate over a copy or an index range; do not pop.
Leave the caller's items list unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: After apply_line_items, the input items list still has its original entries.
issues.do_not_change: Charging price_cents * qty for positive qty lines.

issues.title: Zero qty lines are dropped with no record
issues.whats_wrong: qty <= 0 hits continue, so the line never charges, logs, or errors.
issues.why_it_matters: Zero or negative qty is silent data drop; inventory and receipts disagree with the cart.
how_to_fix: Reject qty <= 0 with a specific error, or keep the line with an explicit skip reason.
Do not continue without a defined rule.
acceptance_criteria: A qty of 0 either raises or appears in a skipped-lines result; it is not discarded.

issues.title: history_page is off-by-one
issues.whats_wrong: end = start + size - 1 and rows[start:end] drop the last id of each page.
issues.why_it_matters: Users lose a history row every page; exports are incomplete.
how_to_fix: Use end = start + size so the slice length equals size (or remaining rows).
acceptance_criteria: history_page(list(range(10)), 0, 3) returns three ids, including the third.

issues.title: Inventory decrement can go negative
issues.whats_wrong: inventory[sku] = on_hand - qty writes a negative count when stock is short.
issues.why_it_matters: Stock integrity is lost; later orders see impossible on-hand values.
how_to_fix: If on_hand < qty, raise or return a structured shortfall; do not write a negative.
Only decrement when the debit is fully covered.
acceptance_criteria: Applying qty greater than on_hand does not store a negative inventory value.
